name: EMA_WMA v2
summary: This EA uses a dual moving average crossover system combining EMA (Exponential Moving Average) and WMA (Weighted Moving Average) to generate trend-following trade signals. It enters long positions when the faster MA crosses above the slower MA and short positions on the opposite crossover, aiming to capture sustained directional moves in the market.
summary_zh: 该EA使用EMA（指数移动平均线）和WMA（加权移动平均线）的双均线交叉系统来生成趋势跟踪交易信号。当快速均线向上穿越慢速均线时做多，反之做空，旨在捕捉市场持续的方向性行情。
strategy_analysis: 该策略基于EMA与WMA的交叉信号进行趋势跟踪交易，概念清晰易懂。入场条件为快速均线穿越慢速均线，金叉做多、死叉做空，利用两种不同权重计算的均线差异来确认趋势方向。出场条件通常依赖反向交叉信号或固定止损止盈，但具体实现可能缺乏动态跟踪止损机制。仓位管理方面，基于固定手数或简单比例规则，未采用复杂的资金管理算法如凯利公式或风险平价。资金管理较为基础，可能仅依赖输入参数中的固定手数设定，缺少根据账户权益动态调整仓位的功能。整体策略逻辑简单直接，但在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This strategy is based on EMA and WMA crossover signals for trend-following trading, with a clear and easy-to-understand concept. Entry conditions are triggered when the faster MA crosses the slower MA — a golden cross initiates a long position while a death cross initiates a short position, leveraging the difference in weighting calculations between EMA and WMA to confirm trend direction. Exit conditions typically rely on reverse crossover signals or fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, but the implementation may lack a dynamic trailing stop mechanism. Position sizing is based on fixed lot sizes or simple proportional rules, without employing sophisticated money management algorithms such as Kelly criterion or risk parity. Money management is relatively basic, likely relying only on fixed lot size parameters from input settings, lacking the ability to dynamically adjust position size based on account equity. The overall strategy logic is simple and straightforward, but it is prone to generating frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses.
pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，新手也容易理解和调试
结合EMA和WMA两种不同权重的均线，比单一均线系统信号更可靠
趋势行情中表现良好，能够有效捕捉中长期方向性行情
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic that is easy for beginners to understand and debug
Combining EMA and WMA with different weighting schemes provides more reliable signals than a single MA system
Performs well in trending markets, effectively capturing medium-to-long-term directional moves
cons: 震荡行情中频繁产生虚假交叉信号，导致连续亏损
缺乏动态止损机制如跟踪止损，盈利回吐风险较大
仓位管理过于简单，未根据市场波动率或账户风险动态调整
cons_en: Generates frequent false crossover signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
Lacks dynamic stop mechanisms like trailing stops, creating significant profit giveback risk
Position sizing is overly simplistic without dynamic adjustment based on market volatility or account risk
improvements: 增加ADX或波动率过滤器，在震荡市中减少交易频率避免虚假信号
加入跟踪止损和动态仓位管理，根据ATR调整止损距离和交易手数
improvements_en: Add an ADX or volatility filter to reduce trading frequency and avoid false signals in ranging markets
Implement trailing stops and dynamic position sizing that adjusts stop distance and lot size based on ATR

risk_points: 均线交叉系统在震荡市中信号滞后且频繁出错，可能导致连续止损
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化，在高波动期可能止损过近导致频繁触发
risk_points_en: MA crossover systems suffer from signal lag and frequent false entries in ranging markets, potentially causing consecutive stop-losses
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels do not account for changing market volatility, which may trigger stops too frequently during high-volatility periods
